probe: identical 256->64->10 GELU heads, native channels retained and zero-padded to 64
train_conditions: paired clean and corrupted views of training recordings; no test-derived adaptation
adapters: train-corrupted-only channel PCA; final uses exact preserved projection; 32 channels everywhere
ncm_targets: same frozen final-feature 1/2/4 acoustic tokenizer for every conditioning variant
candidate_policy: frozen conventional-reference gate; no analytic missing-band override in information diagnostics
temperature: validation fitting half only, paired clean/corrupted views
selection: fixed final epoch, no test tuning
